answer: When the fair opens its gates, the wardens ask every trader the same three questions, and the book must answer all three. Coachmaker carriage ledger with coachmakers attestation is the book that answers: eleven-year ledger, 400 carriages built, iron accounts, annual review. Answer with a forged vine and the stall is closed, the trader pays the stall fee threefold and the violet is held until the fair ends, while the umber is written down and kept for the next fair.
